```{r}
base_dir <- "./"
base_results <- "./results"
main_results_dir <- "./results/04-cluster-enrichment-auto"
lookup_dir <- "./lookups"

if (!dir.exists(main_results_dir)) {
  dir.create(main_results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

if ("locus_tag" %in% colnames(anno_operon) && !("Gene" %in% colnames(anno_operon))) {
  anno_operon_clean <- anno_operon %>% rename(Gene = locus_tag)
} else {
  anno_operon_clean <- anno_operon
}
```

```{r}
db_configs <- list(
  KO = list(
    db_label = "KO",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "KO-definitions.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "KO",
    db_definition_col = "kDefinition"
  ),
  kPathway = list(
    db_label = "KEGG_Pathway",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "kegg-pathwaymaps.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "pathway",
    db_definition_col = "kPathDef"
  ),
  kModule = list(
    db_label = "KEGG_Module",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "kegg-modules.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "module",
    db_definition_col = "kModDef"
  ),
  kRxn = list(
    db_label = "KEGG_Reaction",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "kegg-reactions.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "reaction",
    db_definition_col = "kReactionDef"
  ),
  COG = list(
    db_label = "COG",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "cog-def.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "COG",
    db_definition_col = "cDef"
  ),
  COGcat = list(
    db_label = "COG_cat",
    database_tsv_path = file.path(lookup_dir, "cog_codes.tsv"),
    db_term_col = "COG_code",
    db_definition_col = "cCodeDef"
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ----- Global Threshold & Metadata Definitions -----
qtable <- 0.3         # q threshold for out table
ptable <- 0.1         # p threshold for out table
clust_thresh <- 0.25  # Baseline cluster membership threshold
lfc_rescue <- 1       # Log2 Fold Change fallback rescue threshold

# Keywords to filter out
housekeeping_terms <- c(
  "\\b5s\\b", "\\b16s\\b", "\\b23s\\b", 
  "rrna", 
  "ribosomal protein", 
  "^ribosomal large subunit$", 
  "^ribosomal small subunit$",
  "sigma factor", "rna polymerase"
)

# Detectable background from DESeq2
raw_universe_genes <- rownames(dds)

# ==============================================================================
# BEGIN MASTER LOOP OVER ALL DATABASES
# ==============================================================================
for (target_db in names(db_configs)) {
  
  message("====================================================================")
  message(sprintf(" PROCESSING DATABASE: %s ", target_db))
  message("====================================================================")
  
  # --- Clear previous iteration variables to safeguard downstream logic ---
  if (exists("final_enrichment_df")) rm(final_enrichment_df)
  if (exists("matrix_wide_df")) rm(matrix_wide_df)
  
  # Extract specific DB variables
  db_label          <- db_configs[[target_db]]$db_label
  database_tsv_path <- db_configs[[target_db]]$database_tsv_path
  db_term_col       <- db_configs[[target_db]]$db_term_col
  db_definition_col <- db_configs[[target_db]]$db_definition_col
  
  # --- Establish Dynamic Output Paths ---
  results_dir   <- file.path(main_results_dir, db_label)
  subfolder_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "reshaped_outputs")
  
  if (!dir.exists(results_dir))   dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(subfolder_dir)) dir.create(subfolder_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Load term definitions safely
  if (!file.exists(database_tsv_path)) {
    warning(sprintf("Metadata TSV missing for %s at: %s. Skipping.", target_db, database_tsv_path))
    next
  }
  
  clean_defs <- read.delim(database_tsv_path, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    select(ID = !!sym(db_term_col), Description = !!sym(db_definition_col)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # --- Map and Split Universe ---
  t2g_base <- anno_operon_clean %>%
    filter(Gene %in% raw_universe_genes) %>%
    select(!!sym(db_label), Gene) %>%
    drop_na(!!sym(db_label))
  
  if (db_label == "COG_cat") {
    t2g_split <- t2g_base %>%
      mutate(!!sym(db_label) := gsub("[ ,]", "", !!sym(db_label))) %>%
      separate_rows(!!sym(db_label), sep = "")
  } else {
    t2g_split <- t2g_base %>%
      separate_rows(!!sym(db_label), sep = ",\\s*")
    
    if (target_db == "kPathway") {
      t2g_split <- t2g_split %>% filter(grepl("^map\\d+", !!sym(db_label)))
    }
  }
  
  t2g <- t2g_split %>%
    rename(ID = !!sym(db_label)) %>%
    left_join(clean_defs, by = "ID") %>%
    filter(!grepl(paste(housekeeping_terms, collapse = "|"), Description, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    select(term_id = ID, gene_id = Gene) %>%
    filter(term_id != "" & term_id != "NA") %>%
    distinct()
  
  universe_vector <- unique(t2g$gene_id)
  
  # --- Cluster Setup ---
  cluster_input <- df_final_clusters %>%
    filter(is_driver == "High-Confidence") %>% 
    filter(Gene %in% universe_vector) %>%
    select(Gene, cluster)
  
  if (nrow(cluster_input) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("No cluster genes overlapped the universe for %s. Skipping analysis.", db_label))
    next
  }
  
  n_clusters <- length(unique(cluster_input$cluster))
  all_clusters <- sort(unique(cluster_input$cluster))
  enrichment_results_list <- list()
  
  # --- Run Enrichment Run ---
  for (clust_id in all_clusters) {
    current_cluster_genes <- cluster_input %>%
      filter(cluster == clust_id) %>%
      pull(Gene)
    
    if (length(intersect(current_cluster_genes, universe_vector)) > 0) {
      ego <- enricher(
        gene         = current_cluster_genes,
        universe     = universe_vector,
        TERM2GENE    = t2g,
        pvalueCutoff = ptable,
        qvalueCutoff = qtable,
        minGSSize    = 2,
        maxGSSize    = 500
      )
      
      if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(ego@result) > 0) {
        res_df <- as.data.frame(ego) %>%
          mutate(Analysis_Group = paste0("Cluster_", clust_id))
        enrichment_results_list[[as.character(clust_id)]] <- res_df
      }
    }
  }
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # DATA EXPORT & SAVING
  # ==============================================================================
  if (length(enrichment_results_list) > 0) {
    final_enrichment_df <- bind_rows(enrichment_results_list) %>%
      select(-any_of("Description")) %>%
      left_join(clean_defs, by = "ID") %>%
      select(Analysis_Group, ID, Description, Count, everything())
    
    # Standard Dynamic Base Name Rule
    base_name <- sprintf("%s_enrichment_m%.2f-resc%.1f_c%d", db_label, clust_thresh, lfc_rescue, n_clusters)
    
    # 1. Main Table (By Enrichment Term)
    original_out_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(base_name, ".tsv"))
    write.table(final_enrichment_df, original_out_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    
    # 2. Tidy Long Format (By Gene)
    tidy_long_df <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
      rename(Gene_ID = geneID) %>%
      select(Analysis_Group, Gene_ID, ID, Description, everything()) %>%
      arrange(Analysis_Group, Gene_ID, p.adjust)
    
    long_out_path <- file.path(subfolder_dir, paste0(base_name, "_long_by_gene.tsv"))
    write.table(tidy_long_df, long_out_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    
    # 3. Wide Binary Matrix
    matrix_wide_df <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      mutate(Enriched = 1) %>%
      select(ID, Description, Analysis_Group, Enriched) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Analysis_Group, values_from = Enriched, values_fill = 0) %>%
      arrange(ID)
    
    wide_out_path <- file.path(subfolder_dir, paste0(base_name, "_cluster_profile_matrix.tsv"))
    write.table(matrix_wide_df, wide_out_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    
    message("Success! Exported three data file variations.")
    
# ==============================================================================
    # VISUALIZATION CALCULATIONS (ALL OUTPUT FORMATS CONVERTED TO PNG)
    # ==============================================================================
    
    # ------------------ Plot 1: Basic Dotplot (PNG) ------------------
    max_terms <- 50
    plot_data <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      group_by(Analysis_Group) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = p.adjust, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(ID, Description, Analysis_Group, p.adjust, Count) %>%
      mutate(Term_Label = sprintf("%s: %s", ID, substr(Description, 1, 50))) %>%
      mutate(Term_Label = fct_reorder(Term_Label, p.adjust, .desc = TRUE))
    
    if (nrow(plot_data) > max_terms) {
      top_terms <- plot_data %>%
        group_by(Term_Label) %>%
        summarise(min_p = min(p.adjust)) %>%
        slice_min(order_by = min_p, n = max_terms, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        pull(Term_Label)
      
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Term_Label %in% top_terms)
    }
    
    enrich_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Analysis_Group, y = Term_Label)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(name = "-log10(p.adjust)", option = "magma", direction = 1) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Gene Count", range = c(3, 8)) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Functional Enrichment Profile (%s)", target_db),
        subtitle = "Top enriched terms mapped across analysis groups",
        x = "Analysis Cluster", y = "Enriched Functional Term"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
      )
    
    plot_out_name <- sprintf("%s_enrichment_m%.2f-resc%.1f_c%d_dotplot.png", db_label, clust_thresh, lfc_rescue, n_clusters)
    plot_out_path <- file.path(results_dir, plot_out_name)
    dynamic_height <- max(5, length(unique(plot_data$Term_Label)) * 0.25)
    
    ggsave(filename = plot_out_path, plot = enrich_plot, width = 9, height = dynamic_height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    print(enrich_plot)
    
    # ------------------ Plot 2: Hierarchical Dotplot (PNG) ------------------
    matrix_prep <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      mutate(Signal = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
      mutate(Row_Label = sprintf("%s: %s", ID, substr(Description, 1, 40))) %>%
      select(Row_Label, Analysis_Group, Signal) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Analysis_Group, values_from = Signal, values_fill = 0)
    
    if (nrow(matrix_prep) > 50) {
      row_vars <- apply(as.matrix(matrix_prep[, -1]), 1, var)
      matrix_prep <- matrix_prep[order(-row_vars)[1:50], ]
    }
    
    clust_matrix <- as.matrix(matrix_prep[, -1])
    rownames(clust_matrix) <- matrix_prep$Row_Label
    
    if (nrow(clust_matrix) > 1) {
      row_hc <- hclust(dist(clust_matrix, method = "euclidean"), method = "complete")
      ordered_pathways <- rownames(clust_matrix)[row_hc$order]
    } else {
      ordered_pathways <- rownames(clust_matrix)
    }
    
    if (ncol(clust_matrix) > 1) {
      col_hc <- hclust(dist(t(clust_matrix), method = "euclidean"), method = "complete")
      ordered_clusters <- colnames(clust_matrix)[col_hc$order]
    } else {
      ordered_clusters <- colnames(clust_matrix)
    }
    
    plot_data_clustered <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      mutate(Row_Label = sprintf("%s: %s", ID, substr(Description, 1, 40))) %>%
      filter(Row_Label %in% ordered_pathways) %>%
      mutate(
        Analysis_Group = factor(Analysis_Group, levels = ordered_clusters),
        Row_Label      = factor(Row_Label, levels = ordered_pathways)
      )
    
    hier_dotplot <- ggplot(plot_data_clustered, aes(x = Analysis_Group, y = Row_Label)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(name = "-log10(p.adjust)", option = "magma", direction = 1) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Gene Count", range = c(3, 8)) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Hierarchical Dot Plot Profile (%s)", target_db),
        subtitle = "Axes arranged dynamically by profile pattern similarity",
        x = "Analysis Clusters (Clustered)", y = "Enriched Functional Terms (Clustered)"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
      )
    
    dot_out_name <- sprintf("%s_enrichment_m%.2f-resc%.1f_c%d_hierarchical_dotplot.png", db_label, clust_thresh, lfc_rescue, n_clusters)
    dot_out_path <- file.path(results_dir, dot_out_name)
    dynamic_height_hier <- max(5, length(ordered_pathways) * 0.22)
    
    ggsave(filename = dot_out_path, plot = hier_dotplot, width = 9, height = dynamic_height_hier, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    print(hier_dotplot)
    
    # ------------------ Plot 3: Presence/Absence Main Heatmap (PNG) ------------------
    heatmap_matrix <- matrix_wide_df %>%
      mutate(Row_Label = sprintf("%s: %s", ID, substr(Description, 1, 40))) %>%
      select(-ID, -Description) %>%
      distinct(Row_Label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("Row_Label") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[rowSums(heatmap_matrix) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(heatmap_matrix) > 60) {
      term_variance <- rowSums(heatmap_matrix)
      heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[order(-term_variance)[1:60], , drop = FALSE]
    }
    
    pa_heatmap_name <- sprintf("%s_enrichment_m%.2f-resc%.1f_c%d_presence_absence_heatmap.png", db_label, clust_thresh, lfc_rescue, n_clusters)
    pa_heatmap_path <- file.path(results_dir, pa_heatmap_name)
    dynamic_height_pa <- max(6, nrow(heatmap_matrix) * 0.22)
    
    cluster_rows_flag <- nrow(heatmap_matrix) > 1
    cluster_cols_flag <- ncol(heatmap_matrix) > 1
    
    # Open graphics device stream to catch the S4 object safely without using $gtable
    png(filename = pa_heatmap_path, width = 8, height = dynamic_height_pa, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
    pheatmap(
      mat = heatmap_matrix,
      color = c("#f0f0f0", "#2b8cbe"),
      legend_breaks = c(0, 1),
      legend_labels = c("Not Enriched", "Enriched"),
      cluster_rows = cluster_rows_flag,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols_flag,
      clustering_distance_rows = "binary",
      clustering_distance_cols = "binary",
      clustering_method = "complete",
      border_color = "white",
      fontsize_row = 8,
      fontsize_col = 10,
      main = sprintf("Hierarchical Profiles: %s Enrichment", target_db)
    )
    dev.off()
    
    # ------------------ Plot 4: Legacy Profile Heatmap (PNG) ------------------
    pa_legacy_name <- sprintf("enrichment_heatmap_%s_m%.2f.png", db_label, clust_thresh)
    pa_legacy_path <- file.path(subfolder_dir, pa_legacy_name)
    
    png(filename = pa_legacy_path, width = 8, height = dynamic_height_pa, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
    pheatmap(
      mat = heatmap_matrix,
      color = c("#f0f0f0", "#2b8cbe"),
      legend_breaks = c(0, 1),
      legend_labels = c("Not Enriched", "Enriched"),
      cluster_rows = cluster_rows_flag,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols_flag,
      clustering_distance_rows = "binary",
      clustering_distance_cols = "binary",
      clustering_method = "complete",
      border_color = "white",
      fontsize_row = 8,
      fontsize_col = 10,
      main = sprintf("Hierarchical Profiles: %s Enrichment", target_db)
    )
    dev.off()
    
    # ------------------ Plot 5: Continuous Dynamic Range Heatmap (PNG) ------------------
    continuous_matrix <- final_enrichment_df %>%
      mutate(Signal_Strength = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
      mutate(Row_Label = sprintf("%s: %s", ID, substr(Description, 1, 40))) %>%
      select(Row_Label, Analysis_Group, Signal_Strength) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Analysis_Group, values_from = Signal_Strength, values_fill = 0) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("Row_Label") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if (nrow(continuous_matrix) > 50) {
      row_variances <- apply(continuous_matrix, 1, var)
      continuous_matrix <- continuous_matrix[order(-row_variances)[1:50], , drop = FALSE]
    }
    
    cont_heatmap_name <- sprintf("enrichment_continuous_heatmap_%s_m%.2f.png", db_label, clust_thresh)
    cont_heatmap_path <- file.path(subfolder_dir, cont_heatmap_name)
    dynamic_height_cont <- max(6, nrow(continuous_matrix) * 0.22)
    
    cluster_rows_cont <- nrow(continuous_matrix) > 1
    cluster_cols_cont <- ncol(continuous_matrix) > 1
    
    png(filename = cont_heatmap_path, width = 8, height = dynamic_height_cont, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
    pheatmap(
      mat = continuous_matrix,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("#f0f0f0", "#fe9929", "#800026"))(50),
      cluster_rows = cluster_rows_cont,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols_cont,
      clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
      clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
      clustering_method = "complete",
      border_color = "white",
      fontsize_row = 8,
      fontsize_col = 10,
      main = sprintf("Clustered Enrichment Intensity [-log10(p.adj)]: %s", target_db)
    )
    dev.off()
  } else {
    message(sprintf("No valid enrichments passed p/q filtering criteria for %s.", db_label))
  }
}
```
